name: Tachibana Inori
source: One of the dormitory resident and Takeru's classmate. She is smart enough to earn scholarship at the school. Her family is big but quite poor so she usually takes care of her brothers and sisters. She is quite skilled in housemaking due to usually taking care of her family.
